description: Job board: prepare (unsigned) closing a job whose deadline passed without a delivery (expire). Anyone may call it: the reward returns to the poster, and a bond locked by a worker is split (a report job: half to the poster, half to the sink).

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: prepare_board_expire
